note: SYNTHETIC SIMULATION, 2.5D POINT MASS. Scored on truth. Not a flight result. n seeds on one map is a small sample. Identical runs (same variation, outcome, time to B and path length at 3 dp) count once in every interval.

custom_defaults.source: presets.py SENSOR_SPEC_DEFAULTS, filled by the worker

jitter.path_rule: a drawn A/B pair not connected at the radius (hasFreePath, the worker's free_path rule on the 0.1 m grid) is redrawn; after path_tries pairs the exact A and B are kept (path_kept)

no_path.rule: runs with worker free_path false are shown as no path and kept out of every count, interval and the ranking

time_limit.rule: auto: world.family in long_families => that limit, else default_s (bench.py LONG_FAMILIES)

headline.text: 9 planners tie at the top; run Thorough or more seeds to separate them (n=5 per planner, best 5/5 reached B, 95 % CI 57 %-100 %).

world.frame: local ENU m, origin at A
